notes.title: B.C.E. Hotfix 8/10/17 Update Released
notes.content:
An update to B.C.E. has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game or Steam.
The changes include:

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now name their servers
[*] Players can now invite friends using the Steam overlay
[*] The gamepad now controls the cursor on the main menu
[*] Added a splash effect for players falling in the water
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved legibility of the cosmetics menu
[*] Minor changes to the way blocking works. Punches, rocks, and spears will all remain blockable from the front, but clubs will be blockable from all sides
[*] Game instance now handles and properly reports network errors in the log files
[*] Matches can no longer be started with only one player
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the chat box appearing when switching teams
[*] Fixed a bug where the water in the Cliff map would not kill players
[*] Local players will no longer be able to join the Learn to Play level
[*] The cursor now appears in the Learn to Play level
[*] Fixed environmental kills not showing up in the kill feed
[*] Reverted odds of unlocking a blessed weapon
[*] Fixed splash effects not replicating to clients
[*] Spears will no longer stick to the wall behind the player when thrown
[*] Fixed an issue causing hand cosmetics to not appear in game
[*] Fixed an issue with set bonus particle effects not replicating properly
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Nomad" achievment could not be aquired
[*] Fixed some bugs involving ice breaking on Cliff map
[*] Fixed an issue where the lobby selection object would not self destruct
[*] Club block duration fixed
[/list]

notes.title: B.C.E. New Version 0.8.1 Released | Online Enabled!
notes.content:
An update to B.C.E. has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game or Steam.

The changes include:

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Enabled online play for everybody!
[*] Added a new coconut throwable cosmetic
[*] Added a new boomerang throwable cosmetic
[*] Added a text box to the host menu to remind users to connect gamepads when playing locally
[*] Added new spawn areas to maps
[*] Added new art assets and adjusted lighting
[*] Added special effects to blessed weapons
[*] Added ambient sound effects to every level
[*] A 32 Bit client has been enabled as a separate beta branch
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the way players pick spawns again
[*] Changed the way players level up and use favor
[*] Added more robust video options that now save locally between launches
[*] Changed 1v1 mode so that players must eliminate all stocks in sudden death
[*] Games can no longer be started if there are 2 players on one team, and none on the other
[*] Changed the font on most UI widgets
[*] Changed the Steam wishlist button to a follow on Twitter button
[*] 1v1 mode is now best of three rounds and round timers have changed
[*] Removed the BCE logo from the main menu
[*] Made the tutorial more straight forward
[*] Updated cvars and devcmds
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Many fixes to online stability, functionality, and features
[*] Fixed an issue where players could stack the same spawn
[*] Fixed a bug where an unassigned player could not play after the game started
[*] Fixed the server browser to match up with the label text and removed some useless functions
[*] Fixed an issue where more than 2 players could connect to a 1v1 match
[*] Fixed an issue where the red team would spawn in the center of the plateau map
[*] Fixed an issue in 1v1 where the results screen would not disappear after round end
[*] Fixed fires not resetting in 1v1
[*] Fixed stocks not restting in 1v1
[*] Fixed an issue causing rocks to be invisible
[*] General fixes to favor text, menu flow, and refund amounts
[*] Fixed a number of bugs with spear kills
[*] Fixed blocking with a club lasting too long
[*] Fixed 1v1 games not ending after reaching the win limit
[/list]

[*] Fixed an issue in 1v1 where the results screen would not disappear after round end
[*] Fixed fires not resetting in 1v1

[*] Fixed an issue causing rocks to be invisible
[*] General fixes to favor text, menu flow, and refund amounts

[/list]

notes.title: B.C.E. New Version 0.8 Released
notes.content:
An update to B.C.E. has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game. You may need to verify your cache if you cannot connect with other players.
The changes include:

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]

[*] Added a new 1v1 Game Mode

[*] Added new music, loading screens, sound effects, art, and more
[*] Added a button to join the official Discord channel

[*] Fixed many issues related to the UI
[*] Fixed an issue where server travel would not work correctly in local games
[*] Fixed an issue causing player's meshes to not be synced with their actual character controller location
[/list]
